plugin.name: Open Animation Replacer
plugin.description: Drives BF's labor animations through Open Animation Replacer (Laethas) conditions, so trimester / state changes can swap animation variants at runtime. Requires OAR. You still need to run FNIS, Pandora, or Nemesis after install - BF's custom animation events have to be registered in the unified behavior file. Recommended.

plugin.name: Traditional
plugin.description: Uses BF's classic event-driven labor animation list without OAR. Run FNIS, Pandora, or Nemesis after install to register BF's custom animation events - otherwise labor falls back to vanilla idles.

plugin.name: Fertility Adventures Redux
plugin.description: Wires Fertility Adventures Redux's pregnancy quests, child-support storylines, and announcement dialogue to BF NG's cycle events. FAR's tracked-pregnancy faction is driven by BF state changes (Conception / Labor / cycle ticks). Auto-detected when Fertility Adventures.esp is active.

plugin.name: SPID item distribution
plugin.description: Uses Spell Perk Item Distributor to stock vendors with BF's hygiene / contraception / fertility-tonic items so they can be bought in-game. Requires powerofthree's Spell Perk Item Distributor. Recommended - without it, BF's items are quest-only and you have to console them in. Whether NPCs personally carry such items is controlled by the MCM option "NPCs are having relevant items", not by this patch.

plugin.name: P.A.I.A Expansion (Pregnancy and Inflation animations)
plugin.description: Repoints P.A.I.A Expansion's idle/animation conditions onto BF's pregnancy faction so the trimester-aware idles, sit/sleep adjustments, and inflation poses play during BF pregnancy instead of P.A.I.A's own tracker. Mesh-only patch (no ESP changes).

plugin.name: P.A.I.A base (Pregnancy and Inflation animations)
plugin.description: Adds the Beeing Female OAR submod the base P.A.I.A is missing: its author reserved priority 91044062 for Beeing Female but only shipped the legacy DAR condition, so BF pregnancies play no P.A.I.A idle. With this patch the pregnant idle plays from the 2nd trimester of a BF pregnancy. Requires P.A.I.A (SE / OAR variant); mesh-only patch (one config.json, no ESP changes).

plugin.name: FMR-Immersive Effects
plugin.description: Drops FMR-IE's hard dependency on Fertility Mode and reroutes its stretchmark / areola overlays, morning sickness, cravings, fetal kicks, Braxton-Hicks and lactation spells onto BF NG's pregnancy progress. Overlays band smoothly across all three trimesters and fade out during recovery. Auto-detected when FMR- Immersive Effects.esp is active.

plugin.name: BeeingFemale_RS_ChildActors
plugin.description: Spawns BF-born children using RS Children Overhaul's actor templates instead of vanilla child meshes / textures, so BF babies match the look of every other child in your game. Requires RSkyrimChildren.esm (auto-detected).

plugin.name: BFACreatureChildActors
plugin.description: Enables species-matched offspring from creature impregnations (dog -> pup, falmer -> falmer child, etc.) routed through SexLab or OStim scenes. Skip if you do not want creature pregnancy outcomes. Requires SexLab.esm or OStim.esp.

plugin.name: Womb & Birth-count tattoos
plugin.description: Optional SlaveTats overlay packs that BF can drive from the cycle: the Womb State Tattoo (a womb diagram following ovulation, semen fill, fertilization, pregnancy phases, multiples and birth) and the BabyTracker tattoos (birth-count tally and semen circle). Enable the matching toggles on the MCM Children page after install. Requires SlaveTats; safe to skip if you do not use it.
